sources.purpose: deserialize_any uses visit_i64 for JavaScript safe integral numbers, which loses JSON float value representation
Rust JSON string serialization preserves u64/i64 and Value numbers
Rust JSON parser owns decoding without a JavaScript number conversion

decision: Reuse existing Rust serde_json frame encoding/decoding; JS treats frame as opaque text. Typed CoreEngine.handle remains unchanged. Extra Rust/string/worker copies documented; binary buffer channel remains transferable.
alternatives: BigInt serializer config addresses u64 but deserialize_any still normalizes JSON whole floats/negative zero. JSON text carries existing provider number meaning without a new tag/schema or third-party library.
versions: existing locked providers, Dioxus0.7.10 and wasm bindings unchanged
